positions.thesis: Long gold because persistent central-bank accumulation and debasement hedging keep structural demand mispriced relative to real yields; wrong if real yields spike and GLD closes below 362 by 2026-12-31.

Long NVDA because hyperscaler AI capex guidance still implies accelerating accelerator demand the market prices too cautiously; wrong if any top hyperscaler cuts capex or NVDA closes below 160 by 2027-01-31.
Long BTC because post-halving supply scarcity plus institutional flow creates asymmetric upside at current levels; wrong if BTC loses the 68K support shelf on a weekly close by 2026-12-31.
